title: Claude Gets a Learning Hub, ChatGPT Moves Into iMessage, and Reddit Vanishes From AI Answers
tldr: Anthropic launched The Claude Academy: 355 free tutorials across Claude, Cowork, Code, Tag and the API, plus a new Concise Mode in Claude Code.
ChatGPT Work and Codex now plug into Apple Messages, so enterprise users can search, follow and reply to iMessage threads from the desktop app.
Reddit's share of ChatGPT citations fell from about 4% to 0.5% since mid-July per Promptwatch, a warning sign for anyone tracking AI visibility.

tips.heading: Use the new Claude Academy to close your own skill gaps
steps: Anthropic just published The Claude Academy, a free hub of 355 tutorials, prompting tips and use-case examples.
It covers Claude, Cowork, Claude Code, Claude Tag and the API, from beginner to expert.
Pick the track for the tool you use daily, work one use-case end to end, then point clients and teammates here instead of writing enablement material from scratch.

tips.heading: Build a Grok bot to audit your digital clutter
steps: Go to Grok Bot, download the desktop app and sign in.
Open Plugin and connect Gmail and Google Drive.
Click + in the top left, choose Create new Bot, and describe the behavior you want in plain language.
Name the bot so it stays reachable in the sidebar for repeat runs.
tips.prompt: You are Marie Kondo for cleaning up digital clutter. Audit my email, Google Drive, and paid subscriptions, then create a cleanup plan with no more than 10 items per category. Find emails to unsubscribe from, redundant files to remove or rename, and paid subscriptions I may want to cancel. Do not move, delete, unsubscribe, or cancel anything without my approval.

news.body: OpenAI puts iMessage inside ChatGPT Work and Codex. A new Apple Messages plugin syncs threads into OpenAI's enterprise tools so users can search messages, get updates and send replies without leaving the ChatGPT desktop app.
news.means: Assistants are moving into the channels where client decisions actually happen. Raise messaging-app data in your governance and records conversations before a client's legal team does.

news.body: Reddit citations in ChatGPT answers dropped 86%. Data firm Promptwatch found Reddit's share of ChatGPT citations fell from about 4% to about 0.5% between mid-July and August 14. OpenAI has not explained the shift.
news.means: AI visibility is not a channel you can plan around yet. If a client's content strategy assumes chatbot citations, treat that traffic as volatile.

news.body: Alibaba's Qwen is now the most-downloaded open-weight model family. Qwen passed 3 billion downloads in six months, ahead of Alphabet and Meta.
news.means: Expect Qwen in vendor proposals and internal prototypes. Settle whether a China-origin open-weight model clears procurement and data-residency rules before someone builds on it.

beyond_ai.body: A domain speculator bought grok.bot a month before Grok Bot launched and is now trying to flip it.
beyond_ai.angle: A cheap reminder to lock domains, handles and app-store names during naming, not after the launch date is set.
beyond_ai.starter: Have we actually secured the name for this before we put it in a deck? That is a five minute check that gets expensive later.

beyond_ai.body: A leaked photo reportedly shows the interior of xAI's Colossus II data center in Memphis, the site used to train Grok 5.
beyond_ai.angle: No direct relevance to your work, general awareness only.
beyond_ai.starter: Everyone talks about model releases, but the interesting story right now might be who can actually get the power and the buildings.
